flows.title: Download a Global Account statement
steps: If Business Accounts is in the left navigation column, select an account whose type is Borderless cash under the Business accounts side menu, and open its Global Accounts tab. Without Business Accounts in that column, this is the older web app: go to the Wallet side menu > Global Account instead.
Select the Global Account, then Export > Download.
Choose General account statement, or the statement tailored for Amazon or eBay account confirmation.
